title: Costco Q4 FY2026 results — the 16 weeks ended 2026-08-30, the quarter's traffic-vs-ticket split (net sales already public since 09-02)
source: IR: investor.costco.com/events-and-presentations/events/event-details/2026/Q4-2026-Earnings-Call/default.aspx reads verbatim 'Q4 2026 Earnings Call — September 24, 2026 at 02:00 PM PT' (= 17:00 ET), re-fetched 2026-09-15. PROMOTED estimate -> confirmed by this event's own initial research on that company primary, per the apple-eu-dma-terms-2026-10-01 precedent (proposed in a sibling sweep, confirmed by its owner lane's initial research) — the no-self-confirm limit binds the DISCOVERING lane, which was retail-sales-2026-09-16, not the owner. Corroborated on two independent axes, neither of which alone would carry the flip: (a) SEC EDGAR data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0000909832.json, fetched 2026-09-15 (HTTP 200), whose `fiscalYearEnd` reads 0830 and whose 8-K Item 2.02 record puts Q4 results on 2025-09-25, 2024-09-26, 2023-09-26 and 2022-09-22 — the last full week of September, every year; (b) trade press (theshelbyreport.com, 2026-09-15) stating 'Costco will release fourth quarter and fiscal 2026 earnings after market close Sept. 24, with a call to follow at 2 p.m. Pacific', which is the only read covering the RELEASE rather than the call — the IR page times the call only, and Costco's practice is to issue results the same afternoon ahead of it. Known fetch hazard recorded in the ledger's probe-ref `blocked`: investor.costco.com returns HTTP 403 to a plain curl even with a browser UA (5,884 bytes), and was read only through the session's managed fetcher — a future automated probe of this URL will fail and must not read that as a vanished page. Checked 2026-09-15
notes: Amended from proposals/costco-q4-fy2026-2026-09-24.from-retail-sales-2026-09-16.json on this event's initial research (2026-09-15). THREE changes from the proposal, each load-bearing. (1) STATUS estimate -> confirmed, on the IR primary above. (2) SYMBOLS [] -> ["COST"]: market-events-types.ts defines the field as 'Symbols affected; empty = market-wide', and a single company's earnings print is the opposite of market-wide — the proposal read 'symbols' as 'names this house tracks' and filed [] on the ground that COST is not in earnings-calendar.ts. Same shape as apple-eu-dma-terms-2026-10-01, which is kind sector, impact low and carries ["AAPL"]. The practical cost of [] was that the deterministic screen had no price to diff, so every pulse would have been automatically material. (3) TITLE re-pointed at what the print actually adds, because the proposal's premise is now half-spent: Costco's 2026-09-02 August sales release ALREADY published the 16-week Q4 net sales ($93.9B, +11.3%) and FY2026 ($297.3B, +10.2%), so the revenue line carries no surprise into 09-24. What is NOT public and lands that afternoon is EPS, gross margin, membership fee income, renewal rate, and — the reason this entry earns its place — comparable TRAFFIC against adjusted comparable TICKET, which Costco reports every quarter and which has inverted four quarters running (Q4 FY25 +3.7% traffic / +2.6% ticket; Q1 FY26 +3.1/+3.2; Q2 FY26 +3.1/+3.5; Q3 FY26 +2.4/+7.3). Kind stays `sector`, not `earnings`: market-events-types.ts reserves `earnings` for entries derived from earnings-calendar.ts via earningsAsEvents and forbids hand-entry, and this lane may not edit that file. Impact stays `low`, and the pre-released top line is a second reason for it beyond the proposal's first (COST is not a tracked name and no house playbook keys to it). Research: docs/research/events/costco-q4-fy2026-2026-09-24.md.
